summary:
Independent design review by /root/candidate_inventory, who did not author the prerequisite source or companion tests. Reviewed the current frozen spec 3b7e1b1c3035cd4a09caac94775d04fb957f317083f58cfdb77cd7e8aa7277f8, current design context ef5febd117119afbaf57c36d16d0be049f456393a3eca7a4c017c65a9d0826a4, current node_execution.py/process_runner.py and companion test changes in 7530f67 and 9d8f940. APPROVE for the bounded two-file source-only design; no open critical/high/medium findings in this revised contract.

Confirmed the actual fixed V1 plan invokes npm run test for its primary ts_coverage execution, which also runs pretest. The earlier node_check-only rule would therefore have left V1 broken; the reviewed frozen revision explicitly covers both fixed primary node_check and primary coverage-suite argv, not the shared ts_coverage check ID. The mapping-helper execution shares that ID but has different argv and retains full identity checks, as do all other phases. Rebinding requires a successful process and complete safe inventory content equality against the original independently built build_dist, never merely the preceding identity or expected filenames. Both original and final complete inventories remain in originals; read-only replay checks their equal content, current final identity and existing source/dependency/process bindings. The semantic-contract change invalidates old prepared evidence rather than silently admitting it.

The native design validates the first explicit TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP root before log mkdir, tempfile probing or process launch, rejects invalid roots without lower-priority fallback, preserves default-root selection only when none is explicit, and creates an exclusive per-execution child. Only the three fixed temporary roles augment the existing minimal child environment; Policy cannot supply them and arbitrary caller variables remain excluded. Parent environment and retained owned materials are preserved.

The regression design covers real ordinary-wheel pretest/no-pretest V0/V1, successful-script output drift and rehashed inventory tampering, plus real native child tempfile use, distinct roots, environment isolation and invalid-root rejection before writes. This is design approval only: no implementation/source changes, review recording, approval command, test execution, native mutation launch, V2 finalize or Gate were performed by this reviewer. Current focused checks, full native V2 with all required checks and original five mutations, independent implementation review, same-verifier finalization, Gate and exact-head required remote CI remain mandatory. Node V2/CI activation, real target application, authorization files, thresholds and Policy environment allow-list remain outside scope.
